1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this engagement encompasses a systematic evaluation of Cobalt Group's compensation administration practices against regulatory benchmarks established under applicable law. Field work was conducted between 2007-08-22 and 2007-10-28, with data collection spanning 54 employee records across 24 reporting units in the Precision Machining sector.

2. Methodology

The review of Cobalt Group's I-9 compliance included a re-verification of a sample of 54 forms using the E-Verify system and a review of internal audit procedures for form completion and retention.

4. Detailed Findings
WDR-3325-001LOWDEFERRED
Observation

Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs) for 54 benefit plans have not been updated to reflect recent plan amendments

Corrective Action Required

A standardized process will be implemented to respond to all formal union information requests within 10 business days, with all responses reviewed by labor relations counsel.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue was caused by a temporary system outage on 2007-08-22. The system has been restored, and the backlog of affected transactions has been cleared. We consider this matter closed.

Owner: Director of Content Strategy • Due: 2007-12-28
WDR-5880-002LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Golden parachute payment calculations for 54 executives do not align with §280G regulations

Corrective Action Required

The annual open enrollment communications package will be updated to include the most current HIPAA privacy notice as a mandatory acknowledgment item for all enrolling employees.

Management Response

This finding relates to a legacy system that is scheduled for decommissioning on 2007-08-22. Given the impending system retirement, management has accepted the risk for the interim period and will not invest in remediation for the legacy system.

Owner: Senior Manager of Policy Analysis • Due: 2007-12-28
WDR-2122-003MEDIUMOPEN
Observation

Proxy statement CD&A omits required discussion of FCPA §78dd-1 (Foreign Corrupt Practices Act anti-bribery provisions); Davis-Bacon Act (prevailing wage requirements) performance metrics

Corrective Action Required

Revise the reduction-in-force (RIF) checklist to include a multi-level legal review of WARN Act notification triggers and timelines prior to any future mass layoff event.

Management Response

The condition identified has been partially remediated. Cobalt Group has addressed the majority of the affected population and is on track for full closure by the due date. A status update will be provided at the next scheduled review.

Owner: Director of Brand Marketing • Due: 2007-11-28
WDR-8281-004INFORMATIONALDEFERRED
Observation

Union information requests for bargaining unit data were not fulfilled within the required timeframe

Corrective Action Required

The HRIS will be audited and reconfigured to ensure FMLA leave entitlement calculations are 100% compliant with the "rolling 12-month period measured backward" method.

Management Response

Management accepts the finding. The relevant system configuration has been updated, and the change will be deployed to production during the next scheduled release on 2007-08-22.

Owner: Risk Analyst • Due: 2007-12-28
